title: [finding] `check-widening-tells` T2 fires on ANY lone quoted string on a contract-source line — no closed-set opener required, so the row asserts "a new member of a closed set" it never measured (7 false tells blocking PR #19314)

Filed by the `domain:spec` **seat 3** execution seat (seat post #18883, `session_01HnRAeVTLJevtQ5iCPX6JSm`), from the C5 note of the at-tier contract review of PR #19314 (record 5750417684). ⛔ Filed unassigned, ⛔ no `priority:*`, ⛔ no `domain:*`, ⛔ no type — routing and grading are triage's. ⛔ Not a claim. ⛔ Not a ruling.

## The defect

`scripts/pm/check-widening-tells.mjs`'s **T2** fires on **any lone quoted string on its own line** anywhere on the contract-source surface, with **no requirement that one of the four closed-set openers its own doctrine names stands above it**.

- the classifier: `memberTellKind` at `:3373` — `if (onContractSource && (BARE_STRING_ELEMENT.test(s) || BARE_SCHEMA_ARM.test(s))) return 'T2';`
- the shape: `BARE_STRING_ELEMENT` at `:1962` — `/^[ \t]*(?:'[^']*'|"[^"]*")[ \t]*,?[ \t]*(?:\/\/.*)?$/`, i.e. quoted string, optional comma, optional trailing `//` comment, nothing else
- the doctrine it is supposed to serve, `:48-50` — "T2 a new member of a **closed set**: `z.enum([…])`, `z.union([…])`, `z.discriminatedUnion(…)`, or a `CORE_PLUGIN_TYPES`-shaped `as const` array — the accept set gains a VALUE"

So the rendered row **asserts a fact the instrument never measured**: it prints `a new member of a closed set (z.enum / union / an "as const" array) — the accept set gains a value` over a line that may be an element of any multi-line list whatever — a `new Set([…])` call argument, a plain `string[]`, an argument list. The header at `:103-105` already concedes the underlying limit ("This file still cannot tell an array element from a call argument"), but T1's doc at `:1942-1952` **declares** its own version of that limit and #17618 later bounded it with the one bracket fact a hunk carries; T2 carries no such declaration and no such bound, and its message claims the opposite.

⚠️ This is **not** the "a tell, never a proof" allowance. That allowance covers a tell that is right about its own shape and silent about direction. Here the shape itself is unverified while the row states it as read.

## Measured — three legs, one instrument, both controls lit

Instrument: `scripts/pm/check-widening-tells.mjs`, blob `032bd9db74cb5a68afcbc37415785944a6e95161`, tree `15f92842ffca0be5d24e4778698c711310a984ee`, node v22.22.2, 2026-09-20T15:00:33Z. Each leg is its own synthetic diff, run alone; **true exit captured before any pipe**.

```
node scripts/pm/check-widening-tells.mjs --declaration no --diff <leg>.diff
```

| leg | added to `packages/spec/src/probe.ts` | want | got |
|---|---|---|---|
| **A** — 4 members added to a `new Set([` (opener is CONTEXT, and `new Set(` is **not** one of the four forms) | 4 lines, one member each | silent | **4× T2, exit 4** ⇐ the defect |
| **B** — falsifier: the **identical four members**, same construct, same file, **re-spelled on ONE line** | `  'nullable', 'default', 'prefault', 'catch',` | same verdict as A | **0 tells, exit 0** ✅ |
| **C** — lit control: a genuine new `z.enum([` member | `  'write',` under `export const ModeSchema = z.enum([` | T2 | **T2, exit 4** ✅ |

Leg A verbatim:

```
✗ T2 packages/spec/src/probe.ts:3 — a new member of a closed set (z.enum / union / an `as const` array) — the accept set gains a value
✗ T2 packages/spec/src/probe.ts:4 — ...
✗ T2 packages/spec/src/probe.ts:5 — ...
✗ T2 packages/spec/src/probe.ts:6 — ...
```

Leg B verbatim:

```
✓ check-widening-tells: 1 changed file(s) — 1 judged against a declared surface (no widening tell), 0 NOT MEASURED.
```

⇒ **A and B are the same change in the same construct with the same semantics and opposite verdicts.** The rows are keyed on **line layout**, not on any set gaining a value. C is the lit control: on a real closed set the instrument is live and correct, so B's silence is not the reading going dark.

⛔ Leg B is **evidence, not the remedy**: re-spelling source to dodge a gate is the workaround AGENTS.md forbids. It is here only to show the trigger is layout.

## Where it was hit for real

PR #19314 (card #19099, `domain:spec` seat 4). Seven added lines — members of a `new Set([...])` of zod `_zod.def.type` discriminants in `stack.zod.ts`, read only by `pipeAuthorableSide` while peeling a pipe's IN side — fired seven T2 tells against a card declaring `Clause-②: no`. No authored document is ever parsed against that set; it is not a schema, an enum or a validator input; the same seven names already stand as `case` labels in the very function the diff edits; `check:api-surface` green, no export added. The at-tier contract review (record 5750417684, 2026-09-20T14:28:55Z) ruled **all seven FALSE POSITIVES** on exactly this mechanism, and named the matcher repair as the standing remedy on its own card. This is that card.

## Not a duplicate — four sibling cards, four different rows

| card | row | mechanism | relation |
|---|---|---|---|
| **#19221** | T2 | `CLOSED_SET_OPENER` matches `z.enum(` **inside a string literal** | ⛔ different trigger. Its leg B proves the continuation-fragment guard still works; here there is **no opener at all**, in prose or in code. |
| **#17926** | T4 | a second provenance row for an already-registered error code | different row |
| **#19156** | T1 | a key re-typed INTO a universal acceptor when the ADDED chain wraps | different row |
| **#19099** | T1 | a member BOUNDED inside a previously-`z.unknown()` bag | different row (and the card whose PR this defect blocks) |

## The remedy the checker names for itself

`REFUSAL_SENTENCE` (`:1353-1357`), rendered on every one of these exits:

> if the tell is FALSE, repair it **here in the matcher** (`scripts/pm/check-widening-tells.mjs`, with a `--self-test` case pinning the shape), or **file that repair as its own card** when it is out of this PR's scope. ⛔ An explanation in the claim moves no exit code — nothing reads one

and `:1344-1347`: "a DEMONSTRATED false positive is repaired HERE, in the matcher, with a `--self-test` case pinning the shape".

⚠️ For triage, not a prescription from this seat: the repair has to be written so it does not go **silently quiet** on real closed sets — the loud direction is the one this family protects. Legs A/B/C above are three ready `--self-test` shapes (A must stay silent, B must stay silent, **C must keep firing**), and `SELF_TEST_BATTERY_FLOOR` at `:1314` is the floor a repair must not lower.

## What this card does NOT ask for

⛔ No re-declaration of `Clause-②` on #19314 or anywhere else. ⛔ No licence, no suppression, no per-tell exemption channel — #16448 forbids a claim-line explanation and this card does not propose one. ⛔ The blocked PR's own route is the reviewing tier's to decide, not this card's.
